address: 6161 Yuanjiang Road, Minhang, Shanghai, China Mainland
bio: The committed chef passionately advocates a farm-to-table philosophy and reinterprets traditional recipes from various Italian regions with modern touches. From the dazzling array of homemade pasta, be sure to try his ravioli. The airy interior is cosy and elegant; the al fresco barbecue lunch at weekends exudes a backyard party vibe. Arva is nestled in a remote luxury resort, so driving here is the best option. Reservations are mandatory....
